name: Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc.
tagline: Relieve suffering for people with great needs
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu du produit phare INGREZZA est le principal moteur de la croissance de l'entreprise, représentant la majorité des ventes nettes de produits et soulignant le succès de la stratégie commerciale axée sur les besoins neurologiques non satisfaits.

kpis.explanation: Net sales generated by INGREZZA (valbenazine), used to treat tardive dyskinesia and chorea associated with Huntington's disease.
kpis.signal: Continuous growth of flagship product driven by record prescriptions and strong patient demand, despite lower net prices from market access investments.
kpis.description: INGREZZA net product sales increased primarily due to record total prescriptions driven by strong patient demand, partially offset by a lower net price due to new market access investments to support long-term growth.
kpis._validation: Corrected value from 2.51 Mds $ to 2513.7 M$ (source: 10-K Financial Statements), yoy recalculated as (2513.7-2313.5)/2313.5 = 8.65%

kpis.explanation: Net sales from CRENESSITY (crinecerfont), a first-in-class treatment for classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH).
kpis.signal: Successful launch and significant first-year contribution of novel treatment during its first full-year following December 2024 market approval.
kpis.description: CRENESSITY generated substantial net product sales during its first full-year of launch in 2025, contributing significantly to overall revenue growth following FDA approval in December 2024.
kpis._validation: Corrected value from 0.30 Mds $ to 301.2 M$ (source: 10-K Financial Statements), history corrected to [301.2, 1.7, 0.0] to reflect Q4 2024 launch

kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from all company activities, including product sales and collaboration revenues.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by new product launches and sustained demand for existing products.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased significantly, primarily driven by CRENESSITY sales contributions and continued INGREZZA growth, reflecting successful commercial execution.
kpis._validation: Corrected value from 2.86 Mds $ to 2860.5 M$ (source: 10-K Financial Statements), yoy recalculated as (2860.5-2355.3)/2355.3 = 21.43%

kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold, reflecting production and manufacturing efficiency.
kpis.signal: Exceptionally high gross margin typical of successful biopharmaceutical companies with proprietary drug portfolios.
kpis.description: Gross margin remained very high at 98.2%, benefiting from the nature of biopharmaceutical products and operational efficiency. Cost of revenues was 1.8% of total revenues.

kpis.name_fr: Investissements R&D en pourcentage du revenu
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development of new treatments and therapies.
kpis.signal: Substantial and increasing R&D investment reflecting commitment to innovation and pipeline development across multiple therapeutic modalities.
kpis.description: R&D expenses represent a significant portion of revenue at 35.5%, reflecting the company's commitment to discovering and developing new therapies for neurological, psychiatric, endocrine, and immunological disorders.
kpis._validation: Corrected percentage from 21.6% to 35.5% (source: 10-K, R&D/Total revenues = 1015.7/2860.5), yoy recalculated as 35.5% - 31.0% = +4.5 pts

kpis.explanation: Total costs related to company operations, including R&D, SG&A, and cost of revenues, excluding non-operating items.
kpis.signal: Increase in operating expenses supports commercial expansion and growth initiatives for INGREZZA and CRENESSITY.
kpis.description: Operating expenses increased to support commercial expansion, including sales team growth and investments in market access initiatives for both flagship products.
kpis._validation: Corrected value from 2.24 Mds $ to 2241.4 M$ (source: 10-K Financial Statements), yoy recalculated as (2241.4-1784.8)/1784.8 = 25.55%

kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from partnership agreements with other companies, primarily royalties on partner product sales.
kpis.signal: Stable collaboration revenues indicate durable partnerships and consistent royalty streams from elagolix and valbenazine international sales.
kpis.description: Collaboration revenues, primarily comprised of royalties on AbbVie elagolix net sales and Tanabe Pharma valbenazine net sales, remained relatively stable.
kpis._validation: Verified: value 26.6 M$ is correct (source: 10-K), yoy = (26.6-24.7)/24.7 = 7.69%

stories_kpis.explanation: Agreement to acquire Soleno Therapeutics to expand portfolio in rare disease treatments.
stories_kpis.signal: Strategic initiative to diversify product portfolio and access new rare disease markets.
stories_kpis.description: Neurocrine announced an agreement to acquire Soleno Therapeutics at $53.00 per share, strengthening presence in rare diseases.
stories_kpis._validation: No corrections needed; information consistent with business announcements

stories_kpis.explanation: Expansion of sales force to maximize growth potential and commercial momentum of INGREZZA and CRENESSITY.
stories_kpis.signal: Proactive investment to support commercial execution and market penetration across both key products.
stories_kpis.description: Announced in October 2025, the company is expanding sales teams for INGREZZA and CRENESSITY, targeting completion by end of Q1 2026 to maximize commercial momentum.
stories_kpis._validation: Updated last_data_date from null to 2025-10-31 based on October 2025 announcement in 10-K

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not disclosed specific AI strategy or positioning in the provided 10-K filing excerpts.
